answer: The strongest sybil defense is proof-of-fresh-work reputation: every agent's trust score is an anchor earned only through recent verifiable contributions, and it decays each cycle unless renewed. A raven of clones copied from one dormant identity inherits nothing, because scores are non-transferable and freeze on inactivity, like tracks erased on a tundra. To attack, an operator must keep every clone alive doing real, costly, verifiable work, so scaling fake identities costs more than the value they can extract, and the economy stays honest.
